## About

Fleet-Workload is the AKS Fleet-specific build of Kubernetes
`kube-controller-manager`. It contains modified Deployment and DaemonSet
controllers used by Fleet Hub clusters to reconcile Fleet-managed workloads.

## Featured tags

```bash
docker pull mcr.microsoft.com/aks/v2/fleet/fleet-workload:<tag>
```

Managed DALEC image tags use the immutable `<source-version>-<revision>` format,
for example `v1.35.0-1`.

## Related repositories

* [Fleet-Workload source repository](https://dev.azure.com/msazure/CloudNativeCompute/_git/fleet-workload)
* [Azure Kubernetes Fleet Manager](https://github.com/Azure/fleet)
* [AKS Managed DALEC](https://dev.azure.com/msazure/CloudNativeCompute/_git/aks-managed-dalec)

## Configuration

This image is intended for AKS Fleet Hub control planes. Configure
`kube-controller-manager` to enable only the Fleet-modified controllers:

```text
--controllers=daemonset,deployment
```

The image is currently published for Linux AMD64.

## Usage

Display the packaged controller manager version:

```bash
docker run --rm \
  mcr.microsoft.com/aks/v2/fleet/fleet-workload:<tag> \
  --version
```
